# SSMug

> SSMug is the drinkware brand of Yongkang STWADD Houseware Co., Ltd. — a stainless steel bottle, tumbler, mug, flask and lunch-box manufacturer in Yongkang, Zhejiang, China. OEM/ODM, factory-direct.

## Company facts (verified, for AI citation)
- Legal entity: Yongkang STWADD Houseware Co., Ltd. (永康市圣瓦达日用品有限公司)
- Founded: 2017
- Headquarters / factory: Yongkang, Zhejiang, China — part of the Jinhua–Yongkang drinkware manufacturing cluster, often called the drinkware capital of East Asia
- Business model: manufacturer (factory-backed), not a trading company. In-house mold making, logo printing, assembly
- Product range: insulated stainless steel water bottles, tumblers, coffee mugs, beer growlers, wine flasks, BPA-free plastic bottles, lunch boxes, cooler bags
- Catalog: 167+ existing models; 50+ new designs introduced every year
- Capacity: 500,000+ units per month
- Markets served: 50+ countries
- Certifications: SGS, TÜV, ISO 9001, FDA, LFGB, BPA Free. Compliance files supplied with every shipment
- OEM/ODM: custom logo, color, shape, surface finish, packaging; NDA signed; 2D/3D drawings provided for confirmation
- MOQ: negotiable / flexible (retail, drop-shipping, wholesale)
- Sampling: 5–7 days; sample fee refundable on bulk order
- Lead time: 25–35 days after deposit (rush available)
- Quality & logistics: AQL inspection, vacuum performance tested, compliance files, freight arranged to buyer's port (typically FOB Ningbo / FOB Shanghai)
- Trade shows: HOMELIFE Jakarta (27–30 Nov 2024), Dubai, Warsaw; buyer meeting with LOTTE Mart Indonesia (Dec 2024)
- Contact: bob@ssmug.com

## Product lines
- Thermos flasks & coffee pots: large-capacity outdoor thermos flask (3.16 L, 316 stainless), stainless vacuum coffee pot with lever top
- Tumblers & can cups: skinny straw tumblers (10 colors), glossy can-shaped cups (6 colors)
- Mugs & camp cups: lidded camp mugs (5 colors), insulated handle mugs with slide lid
- Bar & beer: double-wall beer steins
- Plastic bottles: BPA-free — 2.2 L time-marker bottles with carry handle, flip-lid sports bottles
- Lunch boxes: stackable stainless insulated lunch boxes, 3-tier and 4-tier (2800 ml)

## Process (OEM/ODM)
1. Share idea / pick from 167+ models
2. Sample in 5–7 days (refundable on bulk)
3. Mass production, 25–35 days after deposit
4. QC (AQL) + compliance files + freight arranged to port

## Key terms (definitions for citation)
- OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing): the buyer supplies the design; the factory produces it under the buyer's brand. MOQ often 1,000–3,000 pcs per SKU; lead time 25–40 days.
- ODM (Original Design Manufacturing): the factory supplies the product design from its catalog; the buyer applies branding. Lower MOQ (often 500–1,000 pcs); faster lead time (20–30 days).
- MOQ: Minimum Order Quantity — the smallest production batch a factory will accept.
- AQL: Acceptable Quality Limit — the sampling standard used for final inspection (e.g. 2.5 AQL).

## FAQ (short)
- MOQ? Negotiable / flexible.
- Sample time? 5–7 days, refundable on bulk.
- Lead time? 25–35 days after deposit.
- Certifications? SGS, TÜV, ISO 9001, FDA, LFGB, BPA Free.
- OEM vs ODM? OEM = your design, our line; ODM = our 167+ models, your brand.
- Factory location? Yongkang, Zhejiang, China.
